name: Plugins marketplace
summary: Connectors are packaged as installable plugins and listed in a marketplace, so adding a tool is a one-step install rather than manual configuration. In Claude Code, for example, a plugin can bundle MCP servers, skills, agents and hooks, and marketplaces are catalogs hosted in git repos or JSON files.
facts: MCP servers, skills, agents, hooks, commands
Easy installs, but plugins can run hooks and servers on your machine
how: Add a marketplace (an official one or a git repo / URL)
Browse and review what a plugin will install
Install it at user, project or local scope
Its MCP servers, skills and hooks load into the agent
goodFor: Sharing a standard tool setup across a team
watchOut: Review third-party plugins before installing; they can run code
Each plugin adds to the context and startup cost
